panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips section of the Efficiency dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT actor, if(skill = '', '-', skill) AS skill, tool_name,
       count() AS calls, countIf(NOT success) AS errors, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY actor, skill, tool_name
ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT bash_cmd AS command, actor, count() AS calls, countIf(NOT success) AS errors
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND tool_name = 'Bash'
GROUP BY command, actor ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT tool_name, decision_source AS source, count() AS rejected
FROM cc.events
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'tool_decision' AND decision = 'reject'
GROUP BY tool_name, source ORDER BY rejected DESC

panels.title: Files
panels.description: paths relative to project; worktrees folded in

targets.rawSql:
SELECT path, area,
       countIf(op = 'read') AS reads, countIf(op = 'write') AS writes, countIf(op = 'search') AS searches,
       count() AS total, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions,
       arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(actor), ', ') AS actors,
       arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArrayIf(skill, skill != ''), ', ') AS skills
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND path != ''
GROUP BY path, area ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Accesses by area

targets.rawSql:
SELECT area, count() AS accesses
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND area != ''
GROUP BY area ORDER BY accesses DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT dir, countIf(op = 'read') AS reads, countIf(op = 'write') AS writes,
       countIf(op = 'search') AS searches, count() AS total
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND dir != ''
GROUP BY dir ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Files re-read within one session (context churn)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT session_id, path, count() AS reads
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND op = 'read' AND path != ''
GROUP BY session_id, path HAVING reads > 2
ORDER BY reads DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Largest tool results
panels.description: Size of the result returned to the model (tool_result_size_bytes); big results fill the context window

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.ts AS ts, r.session_id AS session_id, r.tool_name AS tool_name, c.actor AS actor, if(c.skill = '', '-', c.skill) AS skill,
       if(c.bash_cmd != '', c.bash_cmd, c.path) AS target, r.result_bytes AS result_bytes
FROM cc.events AS r
INNER JOIN (SELECT tool_use_id, actor, skill, path, bash_cmd FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)) AS c ON c.tool_use_id = r.tool_use_id
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR r.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR r.session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.event = 'tool_result' AND r.result_bytes > 0
ORDER BY result_bytes DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Error rate by tool
panels.description: Share of tool calls with success = false (includes rejected calls)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls, countIf(NOT success) AS errors, round(100 * errors / calls, 1) AS error_pct
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name HAVING errors > 0 ORDER BY error_pct DESC, errors DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Result size by tool
panels.description: Average, maximum and total size of tool results

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.tool_name AS tool_name, count() AS results, round(avg(r.result_bytes)) AS avg_bytes, max(r.result_bytes) AS max_bytes, sum(r.result_bytes) AS total_bytes
FROM cc.events AS r
INNER JOIN (SELECT tool_use_id FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)) AS c ON c.tool_use_id = r.tool_use_id
WHERE ('${project}' = '__all' OR r.project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR r.session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.event = 'tool_result' AND r.result_bytes > 0
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50
